ratios.label: Earnings per share
ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: the EPS row does not reconcile with the statement's own earnings. It reads 0.178 ZAR for FY2025 against 1.20361 implied by net profit 44025000 over 36577348 shares, a factor of 0.15. One of the two rows is filed in a different unit, so the earnings per share is not verified. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
